item.title: Parcel: A desktop mail client for Linux, built with Zig
item.description:
📝 Sign in # Parcel opens on sample mail under its Add account page until it has an account; after that, the palette's Add account (Ctrl+K) opens the page. A sign-in works only with the client that made it, so an account signed in with your own client keeps needing its file. While your project's app is in testing, Google expires the sign-in after seven days; sign in again then with parcel login gmail NAME.
🔗 Read more: https://tangled.org/rockorager.dev/parcel
